name: FUN_WF_DATASET_ASSIGNEES
description: This table contains assignee information required to evaluate the data set rule sheet of the workflow rules spreadsheet. For data set rule evaluation, the main sheet conditions must be met.

columns.name: DATASET_ASSIGNEE_ID
columns.description: Rule assignee identifier. It is used as the primary key.

columns.name: ACTION_ID
columns.description: Foreign key reference identifier to the fun_wf_actions table.

columns.name: ASSIGNEE_NAME
columns.description: Assignee information required for approval. It is based on the user, role, or approval group.

columns.name: START_PARTICIPANT_FUNCTION
columns.description: Hierarchy provider function for the lowest level user in approval hierarchy.

columns.name: START_PARTICIPANT_USER_NAME
columns.description: Lowest level user in approval hierarchy.

columns.name: START_PARTICIPANT_LB
columns.description: List builder type for the lowest level user in approval hierarchy.

columns.name: TOP_PARTICIPANT_FUNCTION
columns.description: Hierarchy provider function for the highest level user in approval hierarchy.

columns.name: TOP_PARTICIPANT_USER_NAME
columns.description: Highest level user in approval hierarchy.

columns.name: TOP_PARTICIPANT_LB
columns.description: List builder type for the highest level user in approval hierarchy.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
